usedFor: Duply holds your generated images, and Microsoft Excel logs each one with “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Image Created” in Duply, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Every image Duply generates gets a row in Excel, giving you a production log you can sort.

watchOut: “New Image Created” in Duply is polling, so rows arrive after a scheduled check.
